question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Authenticate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Discredit**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Authenticate"** means to prove or show something to be true, valid, or genuine. (सत्यापित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The bank authenticated her identity by verifying her documents.
 
 
 
• **"Discredit"** means to harm the reputation of someone or something, or to show that something is false or unreliable. (अपयश देना, अविश्वसनीय बनाना)
 
 
• **Example:** The report discredited the politician by exposing their fraudulent activities.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'Authenticate'** is **'Discredit'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Discredit**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Entitle **(अधिकार देना): To give someone a legal right or a claim to something.

 
 
• **Example:** Everyone is entitled to a fair trial under the law.
 
 
 
• **Scatter **(बिखेरना): To throw or distribute things in different directions.
 
 
• **Example:** The wind scattered the leaves across the garden.
 
 
 
• **Amalgamate **(मिलाना): To combine or unite to form one organization or structure.
 
 
• **Example:** The two companies decided to amalgamate to increase their market share.
